Class InteractionChecks

    • successfulUseEmitsBlockChange

      public static void successfulUseEmitsBlockChange(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Function<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack,net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer> factory, InteractionChecks.LoaderClick callback)
      To reproduce: put a sculk sensor beside a Storage, a Singles, and a Bar Stack. Deposit into and extract from Storage, toggle its permanence, and rotate it with a redstone torch; rotate a Singles item with a soul torch. Each successful use vibrates. Extract one of two Singles items or bars, then the last: the first vibrates as a change, the last only as the block's destruction.
